zh.title: 彩妆内容制作
zh.summary: 彩妆内容制作：将妆造形象设计纳入产品内容交付。
zh.preview: 彩妆内容中，人物妆造与产品表达直接相关。本案将内容制作与妆造形象设计结合，围绕同一项彩妆任务展开。
zh.role: Vivian Adventure 参与内容制作与妆造形象设计，把人物准备与彩妆内容联系起来，共同服务于本案交付。
zh.context: 本案是一项彩妆视觉内容项目。制作需要同时处理人物形象与产品内容，妆造因此是内容工作的一部分。

narrativeSections.heading: 妆造也是内容工作
narrativeSections.text: 彩妆项目中，人物形象直接参与产品表达。将妆造设计与内容制作纳入同一工作范围，体现的是对产品内容与人物准备之间关系的处理。

deliverables: 彩妆形象设计与视觉内容
outcomes: 本案形成彩妆人物内容及相关形象设计交付，体现妆造与内容制作的协同能力。

en.title: Colour Cosmetics Content
en.summary: Colour cosmetics content, with makeup design integrated into production.
en.preview: In cosmetics content, the talent’s makeup is part of the product presentation. This assignment brought content production and makeup design together around the same brief.
en.role: Vivian Adventure contributed to content production and makeup design, connecting talent preparation with the cosmetics content being made.
en.context: This was a colour cosmetics content project. Production involved both the talent’s appearance and the product, making makeup design part of the content assignment.

narrativeSections.heading: Makeup as part of the brief
narrativeSections.text: The talent’s appearance plays a direct part in cosmetics communication. Including makeup design and content production within the same scope addresses the relationship between preparation and the product content.

deliverables: Makeup design and colour cosmetics imagery
outcomes: The delivery combined cosmetics content with the associated makeup design, demonstrating collaboration between talent preparation and production.
